description: Land Title Settlement Department - Amendment to the Ex. Gaz. No. 2046/33 of 22.01.2017 - Cad. Map No.  511210 and others
reasoning: This gazette content exclusively deals with amendments to land title registrations under the Registration of Title Act, specifically addressing parcels of land in various locations.
